\section*{Complete Canonical Equation Registry}
\label{app:canonical-registry}

Master Equation River v1.5 registers exactly one canonical equation read per domain (root, epistemic, human--AI, social, world-system, method): where a chapter restates an object under new notation or a later chapter tightens an earlier formulation, the canonical text is the \emph{latest} formulation, and every prior statement is kept only as an occurrence -- a source map, never a source edit. No manuscript, no \texttt{CANONICAL.json} entry, and no Coq file is changed by this appendix. A \emph{Th\textsubscript{coqc}} tier means \texttt{coqc} accepted a stated \emph{finite} model of the object under \texttt{Print Assumptions}-clean conditions (no \texttt{Coq.Reals}, no classical axioms, no \texttt{Admitted}); it certifies the \emph{internal consistency of a stated finite model}, never an empirical truth about the world the model reads. Table~\ref{tab:canonical-registry} lists every canonical id Genesis-first: the nine-element root spine (\S\,1 of \texttt{COLLAPSE.md}) in the order the line is read, then each domain's readings in the order the domain's own Coq Canon Ledger fixes them. Counts, read directly from \texttt{registry/CANONICAL.json}: \textbf{946} raw equations across 40 chapters collapse to \textbf{253} canonical objects, of which \textbf{9} form the root spine (domain=root has 11 ids in total: the 9-element spine plus 2 further root-domain readings of a spine element, per \texttt{COLLAPSE.md} \S\,1). By domain: root=11; epistemic=49; human–AI=74; social=25; world-system=25; method=69. By tier bucket (source tier text normalized for counting only; each entry's exact tier wording is preserved verbatim below and in \texttt{CANONICAL\_REGISTRY.json}): Th\_coqc=1; definition=109; law/non-collapse/identity=63; hypothesis/Open=30; measurement=10; axiom=3; proposition/theorem=18; Dr=2; governance/finite\_diagnostic=17.
